rationale: V2 requires nonempty PopulationRef.id values, rejecting records accepted by v1 and therefore requiring a major version bump. The optional final_trace_evaluation, trace_end_reason, and Turn.eval_purpose fields define absence as not recorded; those additions alone are compatible. Repeated EvalResult definitions now consistently receive canonical validation policies. The published v1 schema is preserved unchanged.
migration_note: This reader accepts only v2; no v1 decoder, upcaster, or migration utility is provided. Convert v1 records explicitly into separate v2 records and validate them with deserialize_record(); do not merely relabel their version. Empty population IDs require legitimate producer provenance or regeneration, not invented identifiers. Leave unrecorded final_trace_evaluation, trace_end_reason, and eval_purpose fields absent or null rather than inferring them from online evaluations. Preserve the original records.
